as_of: YTD through completed regular-season games (W1 all 16 + W2 all 16 + W3 all 16 + W4 all 16)

scale.note: Same units as 2025 prior pillars in prior-2025.json — lock 2025 raw endpoints.

offense.stat: points scored per game (YTD mean of scored finals)

special_teams.stat: return TDs + FG% vs 2025 league mean

takeaways.stat: defensive interceptions + opponent fumbles recovered, per game
takeaways.map: pg = ytd_total / games; lo = raw_lo_2025 / 17; hi = raw_hi_2025 / 17; t=(pg-lo)/(hi-lo) clamped 0..1; pillar=-5+t*10 clamped ±5
takeaways.verified: Reproduces all 32 prior-2025.json pillars.take when fed 2025 totals over 17 games

giveaways.stat: interceptions thrown + fumbles lost, per game
giveaways.map: pg = ytd_total / games; lo = raw_lo_2025 / 17; hi = raw_hi_2025 / 17; t=(pg-lo)/(hi-lo) clamped 0..1; pillar=5-t*10 clamped ±5
giveaways.verified: Reproduces all 32 prior-2025.json pillars.give when fed 2025 totals over 17 games

sources.special_teams: ytd-st-2026.json from ESPN core team statistics
sources.turnovers: ESPN summary box score for each scored final in nfl-2026.json. Giveaways = team interceptions + fumblesLost. Takeaways = opponent giveaways.
